extra:
## This work (Р-251, second English work of the series)

Source: the English original `starfall-en` (text layer; printed page = physical − 1, `offset` 1 is set; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show starfall-en <printed page>`; page image `pages.py image starfall-en <page>`; physical 1 = cover, physical 2 = credits, physical 3 = contents). Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184): Dreamlands = «Страна грёз», the skill Dreaming = «Сновидение». New terms of this book (Erebus Leaf, Lucky Star, Starfall, Starside, Mindcage, Dream Eater …) — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian) for `kb-terms`; the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.

- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`: the investigators' city — act one; Starside — act two; the Dreamlands and Starfall — finale), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; victims, Gainor, Mara, staff, townsfolk), creatures (the Dream Eater and the Starfall denizens are book records unless they are a known Mythos creature → `instance_of` the shared record; Possessed Townsfolk as a group profile), items and clues (Lucky Star cigarettes, Erebus Leaf, the Mindcage, journals…), handouts 1–4 (text as printed, our translation; handout 4 is the cigarette pack picture), places.
- Places: the investigators' city has no name — its places (St. Mary's Hospital, Overlook Hospital, the Evening Gazette, the Godwin estate, Carver's shoe shop and home, the public library, Victoria's office) go under one book place «Город сыщиков» (or a better neutral name) with `part_of`; Starside is a fictional town — a book place, its places with `part_of` and `number` from the map key; Starfall (the dark city in the Dreamlands) — a book place. Do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`.
- Maps (Р-206): «Starside Player Map» (physical 17) and «Starside GM Map» (physical 18) are `map` records; every number of the key (1–7 on the player map, 1–11 on the GM map) → a spot that leads to the place record; every key line without a record gets a small place record.
- Book-scoped ids `starfall-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/starfall-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): the book has almost no art — cover (physical 1: decide whether it is atmosphere or a scenario picture), handouts 1, 2, 4 (physical 15), the two maps. Mapping `checks/20261115-starfall/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures → `checks/20261115-starfall/atmosphere.json`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; check that terms inside text agree with the record names (e.g. the place name in the description is the same as the place record's `name.ru`).
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books starfall-en --out checks/20261115-starfall/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books starfall-en --out checks/20261115-starfall/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/starfall-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261115-starfall/starfall.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), and the term list (English → Russian).
